_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Esbjerg (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), BUILDOUT O5 batch 2 (2026-10-29). Drafted from OSM only so far; facts from DSB's or Banedanmark's station page, photos or a walk go here with their source. Level names are placeholders until a plan or signage names them.

levels.name: Forhal (station hall) / street level
levels.name_source: DSB station page https://www.dsb.dk/trafikinformation/stationer/esbjerg/, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_dk/860000215.json), read 2026-10-30

sources.note: Danmarks Højdemodel, © Klimadatastyrelsen, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/860000215).
Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts): platform heights (3D research pass; data/stations/research/banedanmark_platforms_DK.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 2).

Platform heights from Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts); 8 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/860000215).

Withheld after the final research pass: OSM has three walkway points here: no route from the platform to an exit. The edits keep the research (platform heights, structures, entrances, amenities) for when OSM or a walk adds what's missing.

platform_refs_source.r19021504: Banedanmark Open Data (CC BY 4.0) platform objects perron 1 / track 1 run alongside osm:way/r19021504; tracks 0, 1 from the register (banedanmark_platforms_DK.csv) run alongside osm:way/r19021504, read 2026-10-30 (data/stations/research/860000215); BanInfo's track numbers were being re-issued then: check on site
